title: Obsidian Energy Announces Operational Update
summary: Robust Belly River and Cardium results in Willesden Green, with three additional wells expected on production in mid-April Continued progress on Clearwater waterflood initiatives with the Dawson pilot commissioned and both Nampa and West Dawson injector wells rig released Highest quality oil produced to date in Peace River on the West Dawson and Nampa pads Calgary, Alberta–(Newsfile Corp. – April 13, 2026) – OBSIDIAN ENERGY LTD. (TSX: OBE) (NYSE American: OBE) (“Obsidian Energy“, the “Company“, “we“, “us” or “our“) is pleased to provide an operational update on our first quarter 2026 capital program.
